summary.text: Julie Gilman is a Democratic member of the New Hampshire House of Representatives for Rockingham 11 who is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election after advancing from the September 8 Democratic primary.
Her career experience includes work as a manager of information systems at Cambridge Seven Associates, and she has served on the Exeter select board.

paragraphs.text: Julie Gilman was born in Exeter, New Hampshire, and graduated from Exeter High School.
She earned a bachelor's degree in architecture from the Rhode Island School of Design in 1984 and worked as a manager of information systems with Cambridge Seven Associates, Inc.
Gilman has served as a selectwoman of the Town of Exeter, on the board of governors of the American Independence Museum and on the Exeter Heritage Commission.
In a 2024 Ballotpedia survey, she described herself as an Exeter native who had been elected to the Select Board since 2007.

Ballotpedia lists Gilman's House tenure as beginning in 2016, and its committee listings show her assigned to the Municipal and County Government Committee for the 2019-2020, 2021-2022 and 2023-2024 sessions.

In the same survey, she listed three campaign messages: addressing affordability costs in housing directly rather than relying only on zoning and tax credits, continuing to address renewable and green energy supply, and supporting and protecting public education.
She named energy conservation, affordable and accessible housing and childcare, women's healthcare, education and statewide historic preservation as areas of policy she is passionate about.
